_comment: Declarative list of MCP servers this machine provisions. Adding a second or third server should be a data change here, not a code change in the installer. Registration targets Claude Desktop and Claude Code only - Pi imports from both (see ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json), so it needs no entry of its own.

servers.name: m365-personal-productivity
servers._envNote: Deliberately empty. The server ships config.defaults.json with a non-secret tenant id, so a fresh clone runs with no host env block. Set TENANT_ID here only if you need to override it - and never commit a real tenant id to this public repository; export M365_TENANT_ID before running setup instead.
